baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three rooted nouns name grain, its chaff, and rayhan in one compact coordination.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line inventories one crop across concentrated kernel, surrounding or post-harvest matter, and green or aromatic yield; the outer matter is part of the provision rather than an accidental remainder.

activation_trace.role: The seed branch supplies the carried, edible, and germinating center of the crop.
The dry husk and broken crop-leaf branch supplies the crop's envelope and harvest residue.
The rayhan-as-plant-or-crop-leaf branch supplies a green and potentially aromatic yield alongside grain.

changed_reading.before: A flat list of grain, chaff, and an aromatic plant.
changed_reading.after: A whole-crop inventory in which kernel, envelope or residue, and leaf or aromatic yield belong to one economy of provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of grain, `asf, and rayhan allows the focus ayah to be read as a material event as well as a produce list.
baseline_models.mechanism: Moving air separates seed from light crop matter while also carrying scent; the same medium sorts one product and broadcasts another.

activation_trace.role: The carried kernel supplies what can be retained when the crop is disturbed.
The sweeping-wind branch supplies the force that lifts and scatters broken crop matter.
The moving-air branch supplies the shared carrier for both separation and diffusion.
The odor branch supplies the perceptible trace that air distributes beyond the plant.

changed_reading.before: The nouns denote stationary agricultural goods.
changed_reading.after: The ayah also stages release: grain is retained, chaff is swept, and scent travels, all through an encounter with air.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Each focus root has a branch that can occupy a bodily slot: inner kernel, expendable covering, and life-breath or relief.
baseline_models.mechanism: The botanical triad can coexist with an embodied analogy in which a hidden core is carried inside fragile matter and becomes appreciable through breath, vitality, or relief.

activation_trace.role: The heart's inner-kernel branch supplies a concealed center rather than merely a cereal grain.
The brittle husk branch supplies the temporary outer body around that center.
The life-spirit branch supplies an animating counterpart to kernel and shell.
The relief-and-return-of-breath branch makes rayhan a possible register of restored ease.

changed_reading.before: Only botanical parts and products are in view.
changed_reading.after: A second, exploratory reading carries the plant as a miniature body: hidden core, fragile shell, and animating or relieving breath.

context_deltas.mechanism: The palm's fruit casing immediately before 55:12 turns chaff from useless aftermath into the former architecture of maturation; rayhan or leafing then marks the plant's opening beyond enclosure.

activation_trace.role: The plant-casing branch supplies an adjacent envelope-before-yield analogue for the grain's husk.
The seed branch supplies the protected content whose maturation the casing serves.
The husk branch supplies the same envelope after drying, breaking, or harvest.
The leafing-and-tall-growth branch supplies the outward opening that follows protected formation.

structural_cues: 55:11 immediately precedes the focus and pairs a fruiting palm's casings with the focus ayah's grain-bearing construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent plant casing, seed, husk, and leafing; I infer a developmental arrow from enclosure to mature opening. A live alternative is that the two ayat merely catalogue unrelated produce features.

changed_reading.before: Chaff is a dry byproduct listed beside the useful grain.
changed_reading.after: Chaff is the spent form of a necessary enclosure: protection, seed, and opening are successive states of one generative design.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence of measure, equitable shares, and earth-for-creatures recasts the three crop outputs as calibrated allocation: concentrated food, protective or recyclable matter, and sensory or leafy benefit.

activation_trace.role: The branch of a created thing formed in due proportion supplies material calibration rather than sheer abundance.
The share-and-division branch supplies distribution among distinct beneficiaries or uses.
The earth-dwelling creatures branch supplies the receiving community for the distributed outputs.
The kernel supplies concentrated nourishment and future propagation.
The crop residue supplies a materially different share rather than an omitted waste stream.
The plant-leaf branch supplies green, fodder-like, or aromatic utility beside the kernel.

structural_cues: 55:7-12 moves from cosmic balance and fair measure to earth, creatures, fruit, casings, grain, chaff, and rayhan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proportion, shares, recipients, and differentiated plant outputs; I infer that the moral language of measure also organizes material ecology. The alternative is that measure concerns commerce alone and does not classify the produce.

changed_reading.before: The ayah displays several kinds of abundance.
changed_reading.after: It displays apportioned abundance: different plant fractions carry different benefits, so apparent residue remains inside the balance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate refrain names favors and activates both cultivation-to-completion and nourishment-to-growth in lordship; the produce becomes evidence of sustained care rather than a finished object dropped into place.

activation_trace.role: The favors branch explicitly classifies the preceding crop complex as benefaction.
The repair, nurture, and completion branch supplies the process that brings seed and covering to usefulness.
The non-dominant nourishment-and-growth target preserves a second mapped route from lordship to plant development.
The seed branch supplies latent growth that requires nurture over time.
The husk branch supplies evidence that care includes temporary structures as well as final yield.
The leafing branch supplies visible growth as the completion of hidden potential.

structural_cues: The first repeated dual-address refrain follows 55:12 immediately, converting the preceding inventory into the refrain's nearest evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favor, nurture-to-completion, a split-root growth branch, and plant stages; I infer that the gift is the developmental process joining them. The alternative is a generic blessing label with no process claim.

changed_reading.before: Grain, chaff, and rayhan are possessions given to creatures.
changed_reading.after: Their favor lies in cultivated becoming: protected potential is nourished into multiple forms of benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later antithesis of passing away and remainder activates different temporal fates inside the crop: plant body dries and disperses, scent is transient, while seed can be withheld and carried into another season.

activation_trace.role: The ending-after-duration branch supplies the temporal horizon for the crop's visible body.
The withholding-and-storing branch supplies a precise mode by which part of a harvest can remain.
The seed branch supplies the storable part that can outlast the harvested plant and restart growth.
The swept-residue branch supplies visible dispersal and loss of the former enclosure.
The scent branch supplies a benefit apprehended as a passing trace rather than stored bulk.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 forms an explicit temporal contrast between universal creaturely ending and what remains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ending, storage of a remainder, seed, dispersal, and scent; I project that contrast onto crop fractions. This does not identify stored seed with the divine remainder; the live alternative keeps the contrast exclusively Creator-versus-creation.

changed_reading.after: It also compresses a temporal cycle: transient body and scent pass, residue scatters, and a withheld kernel can carry life forward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The lexical opposition of heaviness and lightness in the later address activates a material gradient already latent in 55:12: retainable kernel, mobile chaff, and diffusible scent.

activation_trace.role: The heavy-versus-light branch supplies the contrast by which the three focus products separate into physical regimes.
The discrete kernel supplies what can settle, be gathered, and retained.
The branch of swift light motion supplies the easily displaced middle term.
The odor branch supplies an effect that travels without the plant's bulk.

structural_cues: 55:31's dual address supplies a lexical heavy/light contrast after the focus has already arranged three materials with sharply different mobility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the contrast and the three material branches; I infer a graded spectrum rather than a direct gloss of `al-thaqalan`. The live alternative restricts the later term to the two accountable species.

changed_reading.before: The three nouns differ mainly by plant type or use.
changed_reading.after: They form a descending gradient of retained mass: kernel, airborne fragment, and perceptible but nearly immaterial scent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recognition by an outward mark later in the surah makes rayhan's scent an index: what diffuses from a concealed living core reveals an interior that the husk itself hides.

activation_trace.role: The recognition-through-trace branch supplies the epistemic move from an exterior sign to an identified interior state.
The scent-and-perfuming branch directly couples recognition with odor as a detectable trace.
The visible-mark branch supplies an outward feature by which an otherwise hidden condition becomes known.
The inner-kernel branch supplies the concealed center to be disclosed.
The husk branch supplies an exterior that both conceals and materially indicates the kernel.
The odor branch supplies an outward signature emitted by living or aromatic matter.

structural_cues: 55:41 pairs being recognized with marks; the focus had paired a hidden kernel and covering with a scent-bearing term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recognition, mark, scent, kernel, and shell; I infer an indexical arrow from emitted trace to hidden vitality. The context's actual polarity is punitive, so a live alternative denies transfer from judicial marking to botanical disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Rayhan adds fragrance or foliage to the agricultural list.
changed_reading.after: Rayhan can function as disclosure: scent makes the concealed vitality behind kernel and shell perceptible at a distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later garden sequence unfolds what 55:12 compresses: concealed growth branches, receives flowing water, diversifies into paired kinds, and reaches an accessible harvest.

activation_trace.role: The tree-screened garden branch supplies a mature environment grown from concealed beginnings.
The branching-bough branch supplies expansion from one growth point into many extensions.
The flowing branch supplies continuous water movement through the growing system.
The paired-counterpart branch supplies multiplication without erasing distinct kinds.
The taking-of-harvest branch supplies the endpoint at which growth becomes available yield.
The seed branch supplies the compressed beginning of the later garden process.
The crop-leaf and husk branch records protective growth and the residue of completed harvest.
The leafing-and-height branch supplies visible emergence between seed and harvest.

structural_cues: 55:46-54 proceeds through gardens, boughs, flowing springs, paired fruits, and near harvest in alternating descriptive and refrain units.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies all stages but does not grammatically join them into one botanic timeline; I infer the developmental arrow and read the focus as its compact seed-form. The alternative treats each garden feature as an independent amenity.

changed_reading.after: It is also the compressed germ of the later gardens: concealed seed unfolds through water and branching into differentiated, harvestable abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 55:60 the split mapping of recompense coactivates mature cutting and what falls from it; against 55:12, ethical return acquires a harvest model in which cultivation ripens into corresponding yield and residue.

activation_trace.role: The reciprocal-recompense target supplies an outcome corresponding to an antecedent act.
The non-dominant mature-cutting target supplies the moment when growth becomes reaped outcome.
The same non-dominant target supplies what falls through cutting, preserving residue beside yield.
The doing-good branch supplies the cultivated input and its repeated good return.
The seed branch supplies an input whose kind and care condition later yield.
The harvest-residue branch keeps the process material and prevents return from meaning only an abstract prize.
The plant-and-leaf branch supplies the living field in which seed reaches a differentiated return.

structural_cues: 55:60 repeats the same good-doing term on both sides of the exception, while the split root inventory places recompense and mature cutting under one packet cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal good, harvest maturity, cut fallings, and the focus crop; I infer harvest as a material analogy for correspondence. The live alternative keeps the non-dominant cutting target dormant and reads 55:60 only as an ethical axiom.

changed_reading.before: The crop is a benefaction received without an explicit account of return.
changed_reading.after: The crop can model return itself: what is cultivated ripens into a corresponding harvest, with both prized yield and accountable remainder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because rayhan is normally carried as fresh plant, leaf, or fragrance, not as smoke. It remains anchored by dry chaff, the focus root's weak-spark branch, its odor branch, and later explicit flame branches; downstream prose should call it a material transformation analogy, never a replacement gloss for rayhan.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Dry `asf stands between a seed root that includes faint sparks and a rayhan root that includes odor.

activation_trace.role: The faint-spark branch supplies a low-intensity ignition image latent under the grain root.
The dry broken-crop branch supplies readily transformed plant residue.
The odor branch supplies the perceptible output of aromatic matter.
The flame branch supplies vigorous combustion as a later material regime.
The blazing-fire branch reinforces transformation by heat without making it the focus noun's lexical sense.

changed_reading.before: The sequence moves from edible grain to residue to pleasant plant or scent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also move through stored matter, combustible residue, and released aroma: benefit emerges through transformation, not only consumption.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The sea-boundary analogy is cross-domain and does not imply that grain, husk, and scent are the two seas or their jewels. It remains valid because the focus itself juxtaposes separable materials and a wind-driven sorting branch, while the context supplies meeting, non-transgression, and extraction; render it only as a structural analogy of productive distinction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Kernel, chaff, and scent can remain adjacent while differing in mobility, use, and mode of emergence.

activation_trace.role: The discrete kernel supplies a valuable unit recoverable from surrounding crop matter.
The sorting wind supplies differential movement without requiring the materials to lose identity.
The interval-between-two branch supplies a maintained boundary inside proximity.
The boundary-transgression branch, negated in context, supplies disciplined non-overrun.
The bringing-out-from-concealment branch supplies extraction of a hidden value.
The pearl branch supplies the context's compact image of valuable output recovered from a larger medium.

changed_reading.before: The plant materials are merely adjacent items.
changed_reading.after: They can form a productive boundary system: unlike materials coexist, sorting preserves distinction, and concentrated value emerges from a surrounding medium.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it lets humble crop transformations orient an apocalyptic sky image. It remains anchored by the focus's sweeping-breakup branch and the context's opening, rose-color, and oil branches; downstream prose must state that the scale analogy is reader-supplied and not claim that 55:37 comments lexically on grain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can stage intact kernel, broken and swept matter, moving air, and aromatic plant color or trace.

activation_trace.role: The compact kernel supplies an ordinary stable form against which breakup becomes perceptible.
The sweeping destructive branch supplies reduction of an ordered body into chaff-like ruin.
The wind branch supplies the medium through which fragments and traces move.
The cracking-open branch supplies catastrophic loss of enclosure at cosmic scale.
The rose-and-red-color branch supplies a plant-derived visual register for transformed sky.
The oil branch supplies a second familiar material state used to apprehend cosmic change.

changed_reading.before: 55:12 remains a small terrestrial provisioning scene.
changed_reading.after: It may also furnish a low-scale grammar of transformation by which intact form, rupture, scattering, color, and changed material state become imaginable later.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is strongly branch-distant because the context surface denotes restraint, while one inventory branch names remnants of grain and husk. It remains anchored by the exact focus pair and a packet-authorized branch, but downstream prose must present it only as latent reactivation and must never gloss the context word as crop residue.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 55:12 explicitly joins the seed-grain branch to the dry husk and crop-residue branch.

activation_trace.role: The seed branch supplies the retained grain half of the later latent residue pair.
The husk branch supplies the outer and leftover half of that pair.
The branch naming grain-and-husk remnants unexpectedly reactivates the exact focus anatomy deep inside the garden sequence.

changed_reading.before: The grain-and-chaff pair is exhausted once the earthly produce catalogue ends.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, the pair persists as remainder-memory inside later abundance, keeping discarded matter visible beside perfected garden yield.

strongest_changes: The adjacent palm casings changed chaff from disposable waste into the spent form of a necessary developmental enclosure.
Measure, fair shares, and creatures changed the produce list into an ecology of differentiated allocation.
Perishing versus stored remainder added time: plant body and scent pass while a withheld seed can carry growth forward.
The later garden sequence unfolded the focus seed into branching, water, paired kinds, and harvest.
The split recompense root made harvest a live material model for corresponding return without collapsing the ethical and agricultural readings.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah supported several simultaneous scales: crop anatomy, an air-driven sorting event, an inner-shell-breath body, a measured ecology, a temporal cycle, and a harvest model of recompense. The most productive surprises came from non-dominant mapped targets and branch-distant echoes that remained visibly tethered to grain, chaff, or rayhan.
remaining_uncertainties: Rayhan can foreground a known aromatic plant, crop leaves, scent, relief, or leafing; the balance among those branches changes which mechanism dominates.
The air-driven threshing sequence is materially coherent but reader-supplied rather than asserted by the focus syntax.
The relation of `wal-rayhan` to `al-habb dhu al-`asf` may be taxonomic coordination rather than three parts of one crop.
The heavy/light, combustion, cosmic-scale, and qasirat echoes should remain exploratory because their context surfaces activate form-distant inventory branches.
